item.title: 1.0.1-beta.5
item.description:
Improvements

  • Clipboard: pin important items to the top; added optional hover haptics.
  • Haptics: added Light, Medium, and Strong intensity settings; default is Light. Feedback now focuses on sliders, media scrubbing, drag-and-drop, and clipboard hover.
  • Calendar: swipe or horizontally scroll to move between months, with haptic feedback and a smooth transition.
  • Onboarding: preserves already installed modules when onboarding runs again.
  • Settings: restored the Quick Share service picker; removed the obsolete Shortcuts section.
  • Music: reduced opened-notch waveform height for a more balanced layout.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.1-beta.4...v1.0.1-beta.5

item.title: 1.0.1-beta.4
item.description:
Improvements

  • Notch motion profiles: added Polished, Spring, and Minimal styles under Appearance. Respects system Reduce Motion.
  • Notch edge gradient: masked to expanding and open states only. Fixes transition flash near physical notch.
  • Segmented pickers: converted settings comboboxes to sliding segmented controls.
  • Action buttons: styled destructive and reset actions red. Standard buttons use configured accent color.
  • Performance: stopped spectrogram timeline updates during idle audio to minimize closed-notch CPU usage.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.1-beta.3...v1.0.1-beta.4

item.title: 1.0.1-beta.3
item.description:
What's Changed

  • Onboarding Module Selection: New users can now choose which notch modules to install and enable during onboarding (Clipboard, Shelf, Calendar, Camera) instead of starting with hidden tabs (#40, #45).

  • Settings → About Improvements:

    • Added a "Run Onboarding Again" button to re-trigger the onboarding flow at any time (#45).
    • Cleaned up the About screen by removing the duplicate "Thanks" section (retained in README) (#45).

  • Issue Templates: Version dropdown now sorts releases chronologically (newest first), grouping stable releases before betas and excluding upstream fork tags (#47).

Full Changelog: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.1-beta.2...v1.0.1-beta.3
